labeling_note: Model-agnostic framework; prompt/agent risks are applicable, but project-owned datasets and fixed model versions are not.

criteria.rationale: Python dependencies are declared in pyproject.toml.
A dependency manifest exists, but no lockfile or reproducible container build is provided.
The framework does not ship a project-owned dataset workflow.
The framework supports many model providers and does not own a model card.
Apache-2.0 applies to the code; no project-owned model license is involved.
The repository provides a test target and a test suite for executable verification.
No training experiment is conducted by the framework repository.
Tests, CI and Make targets provide reproducible verification commands.
Prompt files are shipped, but no prompt version or hash metadata is recorded.
Sampling parameters appear in documentation, but no fixed project configuration is provided.
RAG is shown as an example/integration, not a project-owned index.
The framework supports agent tool calls, but no mandatory trace/log artifact is provided.
Benchmark and split concepts are mentioned, but contamination and a complete evaluation protocol are missing.
Cost is discussed qualitatively, but no reproducible cost or latency measurement is provided.
